approval.scope: Only five recorded maybe-uninitialized diagnostics: BoundedPageAllocator FreePages and Torque field synchronization load/store selection.

scope: Only five recorded maybe-uninitialized diagnostics: BoundedPageAllocator FreePages and Torque field synchronization load/store selection.

root_causes.allocator: Both named PageFreeingMode cases assign success; the zero-initialized path assigns it via DecommitPages. The four valid initialization/freeing combinations always initialize success before return. GCC additionally considers unnamed enum representations.
root_causes.torque: All three FieldSynchronization values assign the selected load/store name or invoke noreturn ReportError for unsupported plain/weak acquire-release modes. The weak-store branch assigns its constant directly. No accepted path consumes an uninitialized name.

controls.coverage: Four valid allocator mode pairs, success and injected failure from underlying allocator, exact operation/address/length/free-region accounting; all three synchronization modes for plain/tagged load, plain store and strong/weak tagged store; unsupported operations must throw. 10000 iterations.
controls.limitations: Unchanged method/branch bodies and enum declarations are copied with source hashes. Allocator and error reporting dependencies are observable adapters; this does not replace full Node tests or exercise operating-system page allocation. Invalid private enum representations are outside the constructor/caller contract.

exclusions: No compiler suppression, default initialization or runtime behavior changes. Other enum and guarded-state diagnostics are excluded.
